note: The root key uses the place name’s own consonants. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Hobah is a place north of Damascus. Abram pursued his opponents as far as Hobah.

senses.definition: The place north of Damascus that marks the limit of Abram’s pursuit.

evidence.note: עַד חוֹבָה gives the endpoint of the pursuit. The relative clause identifies the place by its position north of Damascus.
